results.title: 10 Best Countries To See Penguins In Their Natural Habitat
results.description: Penguins are often associated with icy landscapes, but they actually thrive in diverse environments worldwide. Various countries, from South Africa to Australia, present opportunities to experience these birds up close in their natural habitats. Notably, the Galápagos Islands illustrate how certain species have adjusted to warmer climates. Engaging in responsible tourism is essential for ensuring the continuation of these remarkable avian populations in the wild.

results.title: ‘Mother was swept away’: Nepal flood survivors cling to hope amid search for missing
results.description: Five-year-old Ishara Tamang lies in a hospital bed in Kathmandu, injured and separated from her family, after surviving the flash floods that devastated Rasuwa district on the Nepal-Tibet border.
